reconciliation_rule: Do not infer that the transition is a simple historical 49 plus five named indicators. The 49 and 54 counts describe different programme snapshots and scope semantics. lineage_audit_questions: Which historical P18 indicator slots were later retired/replaced?
Which successor indicators were promoted during P19–P25?
Which aliases or semantically related indicators entered the active county cascade after the P18 baseline?
Which current indicators represent replacement concepts rather than net-new concepts?

known_semantic_relationships_to_review.note: Both currently represent the KHS main-grid electricity concept in the active cascade; P27.2 must determine whether the public 54 framework intentionally retains both as distinct slots/aliases or consolidates presentation without rewriting historical lineage.
These are intentionally distinct concepts: dated 2023 census-assessed facilities versus current facility stock. They must not be collapsed merely because their labels are similar.

invariants: P27 target indicator count remains exactly 54 unless a separately approved scope-change process explicitly amends the successor contract.
No historical membership change is invented from count arithmetic alone.
Current active cascade membership is the authoritative P27.1 inventory source.
